subject: MAP draft: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft & owners for Integration build plan

Hi Samantha / Raj —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap + next steps so we have a shared MAP draft to iterate on. Attached is a first-pass MAP focused on the Integration Build Plan milestone (SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs). Please confirm owners and any missing dependencies.

Proposed milestones / owners / Redwood owner (first pass):
- SDK integration: Acme owner: Raj Patel; Redwood owner: Marissa Cole
- Streaming (server-side streaming + client SDK): Acme owner: Carlos Mendoza; Redwood owner: Marissa Cole
- Tool calling (external tool invocation + validation): Acme owner: Samantha Lee (PM); Redwood owner: Elliot Price
- Structured outputs (JSON schema + validation): Acme owner: Raj Patel; Redwood owner: Marissa Cole

Dependencies we flagged on the call:
- API key / auth scheme + IP allowlist (Security sign-off)
- Schema for structured outputs (contract + test vectors)
- Network bandwidth requirement validation for streaming
- SDK language targets (JS + Python)

Target close date for the MAP milestone (mutual): 2026-10-15

Please reply with any owner changes or a preferred target date. If this looks good I will push the MAP to the shared Drive and add action owners in the HubSpot playbook.

Attachments:
- acme_map_draft_v1.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft & owners for Integration build plan

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear recap. Quick updates from our side after syncing with Eng and Security: 

- Confirmed owners (Acme):
  - SDK integration: Raj Patel (ENG) — primary
  - Streaming: Carlos Mendoza (ENG) — primary; PM oversight: me
  - Tool calling: Samantha Lee (PM) — primary; Eng supporting: Carlos
  - Structured outputs: Raj Patel (ENG) — primary

- Security has one outstanding ask: need to validate token rotation and KMS integration before we start streaming tests. That will be a blocker for acceptance testing unless we scope a short staging-only test with a dedicated key.

- Timeline: we can commit to the target close date but would prefer a buffer; propose target close date 2026-10-22 to allow for the security validation and a short pilot.

I edited a copy of your MAP and added comments — attaching our action items spreadsheet that maps owners to tasks.

Attachments:
- acme_map_action_items.xlsx (Excel)

Ben / Elliot —

Great — locking in owners on the Redwood side and listing immediate delivery tasks so we can track resource allocation. I pushed the MAP v2 to the shared Drive and added the action items to the HS deal.

Redwood owners & immediate tasks:
- SDK integration (Marissa Cole): confirm SDK target languages (JS, Python), assign 2 engineers for initial integration sprint, draft SDK examples for Acme
- Streaming (Marissa Cole): staging environment + perf tests; coordinate with infra for bandwidth smoke test
- Tool calling (Elliot Price): build tool invocation harness, develop validation tests and failure-mode handling
- Structured outputs (Marissa Cole): finalize JSON schema + test vectors, create conformance checklist

Open blockers: Security evidence for token rotation (Samantha will confirm), timeline buffer to 2026-10-22 (accepted)
